armmale.n: Male Reproductive System - Hormonal Function and Regulation (sperm synthesis and maturation)

armfem.n: Female Reproductive System - Menstrual Cycle, Hormones and Regulation

One more hypothalamic-pituitary axis: How does GnRH control LH and FSH?
Listen for GnRH from the hypothalamus driving LH and FSH release from the anterior pituitary.
Two cells in each gonad: What do LH and FSH do in the testis?
Listen for LH acting on the Leydig cells and FSH acting on the Sertoli cells.
What do LH and FSH do in the ovary?
Listen for how LH and FSH act on the follicle to make estrogen.
Leydig cells and Sertoli cells: How do the Leydig and Sertoli cells work together?
Listen for testosterone from the Leydig cells and androgen-binding protein from the Sertoli cells.
Listen for the stages a germ cell passes through as it becomes a sperm.
Feedback in the male: How do testosterone and inhibin turn the axis down?
Listen for testosterone lowering LH and inhibin lowering FSH.
Testosterone from outside: Why does extra testosterone lower LH?
Listen for high testosterone inhibiting LH release from the pituitary.
Days 1 to 7: follicles start to grow: What happens in the follicular phase?
Listen for FSH, the growing follicles and the rise in estrogen.
What happens in the ovary during a cycle?
Listen for the follicles growing and one becoming dominant.
The feedback flips: What sets off the LH surge?
Listen for estrogen switching from holding LH down to driving it up.
How do the cycle hormones feed back on each other?
Listen for the feedback loops between the ovary and the pituitary.
Ovulation: What happens to the follicle at ovulation?
Listen for the follicle rupturing and releasing the egg.
The corpus luteum: What happens in the luteal phase?
Listen for the corpus luteum making progesterone.
Why some cycles are longer: What happens in the luteal phase?
Listen for the corpus luteum and what happens when it breaks down.
Rebuilding the lining: How do the hormones change the uterine lining?
Listen for estrogen building up the lining after menstruation.
Getting ready for an embryo: What does progesterone do to the lining?
Listen for progesterone from the corpus luteum preparing the lining.
How do the hormones change the uterine lining?
Listen for the secretory changes after ovulation.
When the corpus luteum dies: Listen for the fall in progesterone when the corpus luteum breaks down.
Reading the whole cycle: How do I read the cycle graph?
Listen for which peak comes first and what each curve is doing before ovulation.
How do I read the second half of the graph?
Listen for the progesterone peak after ovulation.
Implantation and hCG: How does hCG keep the corpus luteum alive?
Listen for hCG from the placenta keeping the corpus luteum making progesterone.
The placenta takes over: Listen for the placenta as an organ that serves both the mother and the fetus.
Listen for hCG early on and progesterone keeping the uterus quiet.
Labor as a loop: Listen for stretch receptors, oxytocin and stronger contractions feeding each other.
Listen for the contractions and what drives them.
Making milk and letting it down: How is milk made and released?
Listen for the alveoli and ducts of the breast and how milk is produced.
